Ledgerly pricing

The Free plan covers up to three clients with unlimited invoices. Paid plans are priced per studio: pricing on request, please contact sales for a quote.

Frequently asked questions

Is there a free plan?

Yes. The Free plan supports up to three clients with unlimited invoices and never expires.

How are paid plans priced?

Per studio, based on team size. Contact sales for a quote.

Can I cancel at any time?

Yes. Cancel from your account settings; you keep access until the end of the billing month.
